title: [v0.92.1][AWS-E] AWS resource adoption register
body:
## Outcome

Produce one accepted AWS resource adoption register reconciled with live state.

## Primary deliverable

One accepted adoption register mapping every durable resource to retain, import, replace, retire-later, ephemeral, or frozen-unknown ownership.

## Verification result

Live inventory, Terraform, CloudFormation, scripts, tags, lifecycle, retention, and deletion-authority checks agree with no dual-managed resource.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one accepted adoption register; imports, tagging changes, and authorized cleanup are internal or follow-up actions and cannot substitute for the register.

## Dependencies

- AWS-D: #487

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every durable resource has one management authority
- [ ] Website and historical evidence ownership is preserved
- [ ] Cleanup requires exact non-use retention recovery and deletion authority
- [ ] Live and declared state agree

## Owned paths

- `docs/operations/cloud/aws/adoption/**`
- `infra/aws/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/cloud/aws-e/**`

## PVF lanes

- `live-state-reconciliation`
- `authority-exclusivity`
- `retention-and-deletion`
- `tag-and-lifecycle`
- `rollback`

## Stop conditions

- A resource may belong to website or retained evidence
- Dual management is possible
- Deletion authority is missing

## Non-goals

- Speculative cleanup
- Website rewrite
- CloudFormation retirement
